escape\n\n    ```\n\n\n    /[\\r\\n\\q{\\r\\n|NEWLINE}]/v;\n\n    ```\n\nYou can enable this proposal using the \n\n```\n\nBabel relies on different third-party packages to transform regular expressions: we are grateful to the maintainers of [regjsparser](https://github.com/jviereck/regjsparser/),
